screenshots-few.title: Add more screenshots
screenshots-few.why: Fewer than four screenshots may not show enough of the app experience.
screenshots-few.fix: Add at least four clear screenshots that show real product moments.
screenshots-few.notEvaluated: The screenshot count was not observed.

rating-low.title: Watch the store rating
rating-low.why: A rating below {{minimum}} can make people hesitate before installing.
rating-low.fix: Review recent feedback and fix the most repeated product problem first.
rating-low.notEvaluated: The store rating was not observed.

stale-update.title: Refresh the app listing

stale-update.fix: Publish accurate release notes when the next useful update ships.
stale-update.notEvaluated: The last update date was not observed.

stores-diverge.title: Align the store titles
stores-diverge.why: The paired titles describe the app differently across stores.
stores-diverge.fix: Use the same recognizable product name and promise in both stores.
stores-diverge.notEvaluated: Both paired listings must be observed for this check.

ratings-diverge.title: Review the rating gap
ratings-diverge.why: The paired store ratings differ by {{difference}} points.
ratings-diverge.fix: Compare recent feedback in each store and address the store-specific issue.
ratings-diverge.notEvaluated: Both paired ratings must be observed for this check.

categories-diverge.title: Align the store categories
categories-diverge.why: The paired listings use unrelated store categories.
categories-diverge.fix: Choose categories that describe the same product purpose in both stores.
categories-diverge.notEvaluated: Both paired category lists must be observed for this check.
